title: JazzSealedDeviceBundleV1Envelope
description: Canonical JSON ciphertext envelope. The exact bytes are persisted and returned on retry; resealing the same bundle is forbidden because it would create a second delivery truth.

protected.description: Unpadded base64url of the canonical JazzSealedDeviceBundleV1Protected object.

iv.description: Unpadded base64url of the 12-byte AES-GCM nonce.

ciphertext.description: Unpadded base64url of at most 131072 encrypted signed-bundle bytes.

tag.description: Unpadded base64url of the 16-byte AES-256-GCM authentication tag.
